content.tex: B MODELLING (QUESTIONS 8 to 12)
REFLECTING A LASER BEAM (30 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 50 minutes on this part.
This task looks at models for the height of the image of a reflected laser beam on a vertical wall. In this task all the measurements are in metres.
The diagram shows, by a dashed line, the side view of the path of a laser beam.

The laser beam \(\bullet\) starts at source \(L\) \(\bullet\) travels to a point \(R\) on horizontal ground \(AB\) \(\bullet\) reflects at the point \(R\) so that angle LRA \(=\) angle NRB \(\bullet\) travels to \(N\) , its image, on a vertical wall.
The height of \(L\) above the horizontal ground is \(LA = 4\) . The height of \(N\) above the horizontal ground is \(NB = h\) . \(AR = 6\) and \(RB = 15\) .
